untouched. 409 body: detail, error (reauth_required, wrong_app, missing_scopes,
import_unsupported, provider_unavailable, accounts_unavailable) and reauth_required.

post.description:
One sheet entry's preview and column types (as preview and types), from one read. A
tab up to sheets_inline_cells is checked now: 200 {status: succeeded, result: {preview,
types, service_account}}. A bigger one goes to the sheets job: 202 {id, status: running,
rows}; sheet_check.succeeded or .failed follows, then GET /v1/google-sheets/checks/{id}.
Errors as preview and types.

schema.title: Response Check Sheet V1 Destinations  Destination Id  Google Sheets Checks Post

post.description:
A spreadsheet's title, tabs and named ranges, read as the destination's account (the
account its Google Sheets connections read as), before any connection exists. Metadata
only. Errors: 422 invalid_url, 403 not_shared (share it with service_account), 404
not_found, 502 error; each with code, detail and service_account.

One sheet entry's first rows as a sync loads them (the tap's own table code: header
row, blank rows skipped, column names), read as the destination's account: its columns
with the header each came from, the header's sheet row, the row count and the first 8
rows. Errors as inspect, plus 422 invalid (a bad entry), range_not_found and empty, and
413 large (a tab over sheets_inline_cells: ask for a check instead).

What each column of one sheet entry can load as: the types that convert its values
(tried in BigQuery as the silver step casts them), a suggestion when every value
converts, a question when a date reads as month/day and day/month, and per option (and
for the chosen config: columns: name -> candidate id or a stored config) the first
conversions and the values that wouldn't convert. Read and queried as the destination's
account. 413 large as preview.
